rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a cooker used to heat food.

example.english: The stove in my home has broken, so I need to buy a new one.
example.traditional: 我屋企個煮食爐壞咗，要買個新嘅。
example.jyutping: ngo5 uk1 kei2 go3 zyu2 sik6 lou4 waai6 zo2 jiu3 maai5 go3 san1 ge3

rows.note: Use this for the stovetop or individual hotplate area rather than the whole cooker.

example.english: This stove burner isn't hot enough to cook the steak through.
example.traditional: 呢個爐頭唔夠熱，煎唔熟塊扒。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 lou4 tau4 m4 gau3 jit6 zin1 m4 suk6 faai3 paa4

rows.note: Use this for a heater intended to warm a room.

example.english: It's dangerous to sleep with the stove on.
example.jyutping: hoi1 zyu6 nyun5 lou4 fan3 gaau3 hou2 ngai4 him2
